content:
Nora F: Morning team 10:24am PT  Received invoice from CloudMetrics (INV-2025-777) for $14,400 but vendor also sent a second PDF labeled INV-2025-777-DUP for same amount. Neither PDF shows a PO number. PDF links: https://s3.company/cloudmetrics/INV-2025-777.pdf , https://s3.company/cloudmetrics/INV-2025-777-DUP.pdf 
Diego R: Yikes duplicate. Did NetSuite already ingest one? 
invoices-bot: New invoice INV-2025-777 uploaded by Nora F. Status: "Needs Coding/Approval". Duplicate flag: not set.
Priya M: Procurement check: Coupa shows PO 115890 for CloudMetrics with remaining budget $2,100. Original PO unit pricing differs from this invoice line items. Could be an overage + duplicate.
Nora F: Line items: "data egress overage" $9,000 + "support retainer" $5,400. PO 115890 covers only the support retainer. Egress should be billed to project GL 7420.
Diego R: We should block payment until vendor confirms which invoice is correct and why there's a duplicate. Also need PO reference for support retainer line. 
procurement-bot: PO 115890 status: OPEN. Last_approved_amount: $12,000. Remaining: $2,100. Suggested action: vendor confirmation + remittance with PO# or match support line only.
Priya M: If support retainer matches PO 115890 we can match that line only and put the egress on a non-PO invoice. But vendor must indicate PO 115890 on the reissued invoice for the support line.
Nora F: I'll email vendor: "Please confirm invoice intent for INV-2025-777 (duplicate received). Reissue corrected invoice(s) that: 1) reference PO 115890 for support retainer, and 2) provide detailed egress log for reconciliation. If duplicate was sent in error, kindly issue a credit note for the duplicate." 
Diego R: Can we provisionally code the support retainer to GL 6602 and route approval for $5,400 while holding the $9k egress? CFO sign-off needed for >$10k combined but individual line under threshold. 
Elena S: FYI I'm OK with match-and-route for the confirmed PO-covered line only. Finance policy: do not pay duplicate invoices; hold disputed amounts. Route the $5,400 to L2 approver and require vendor reissue/credit for the duplicate.
invoices-bot: Action logged: Hold payment for INV-2025-777 disputed lines. NS-INV-13101 updated. Notify: vendor@cloudmetrics.
Priya M: Vendor replied: "Apologies, second file was an internal resend. We'll send a corrected single invoice with PO# 115890 on the support line and an itemized CSV for egress. Credit note for duplicate to follow." 
Nora F: Great. I'll attach corrected invoice when received and then Diego can code/post the support line. Leaving thread open until credit note arrives. :white_check_mark:
